# Candidate Occurrence Reconciliation

## Deterministic grouped audit trail

The maximum-recall index defines each occurrence as one indexed phrase matching one source line. The global index preserves phrase-to-line locations. This reconciliation supplies a disjoint, exact source-line disposition partition. Therefore every individual occurrence is traceable by intersecting its indexed phrase location with exactly one disposition line set below.

Disposition rules: EXTRACTED = line falls in a provenance-wrapped historical artifact range; DUPLICATE = recurring status/title/cross-reference outside a preserved range; REVIEWED BUT NON-MATERIAL = contextual reference outside a preserved range. No occurrence is implicit.
